title: How Christopher Nolan Writes and Directs a Movie | The Director's Chair
speaker: StudioBinder
zh: 【StudioBinder】克里斯多福諾蘭如何編劇和導演電影 |導演椅（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: One of the things I love about directing is the multi-faceted nature of the challenge.
cues.en: One of the things I love about directing is the multi-faceted nature of the challenge.
cues.zh: 我喜歡導演的原因之一是挑戰的多面性。

cues.text: The idea of a narrative that's a maze or labyrinth.
cues.en: The idea of a narrative that's a maze or labyrinth.
cues.zh: 迷宮或迷宮的敘事概念。

cues.text: Rather than being above that maze, and watching the characters make mistakes and wrong turns,
cues.en: Rather than being above that maze, and watching the characters make mistakes and wrong turns,
cues.zh: 而不是在迷宮之上，看著角色犯錯誤和走錯彎，

cues.text: you would enter into the maze, kind of looking over their shoulder, and make the wrong turns with them
cues.en: you would enter into the maze, kind of looking over their shoulder, and make the wrong turns with them
cues.zh: 你會進入迷宮，從他們的肩膀後面看，然後和他們一起走錯彎

cues.text: and find a blind alleys with them.
cues.en: and find a blind alleys with them.
cues.zh: 並與他們一起找到死衚衕。

cues.text: There's a feeling of reality.
cues.en: There's a feeling of reality.
cues.zh: 有一種真實的感覺。

cues.text: There's a feeling of being somewhere that matters.
cues.en: There's a feeling of being somewhere that matters.
cues.zh: 有種身處某個重要地方的感覺。

cues.text: I approached the structure from very mathematical and geometrical point of view.
cues.en: I approached the structure from very mathematical and geometrical point of view.
cues.zh: 我從數學和幾何的角度來研究這個結構。

cues.text: A lot of diagrams, lot of careful planning.
cues.en: A lot of diagrams, lot of careful planning.
cues.zh: 很多圖表，很多仔細的計畫。

cues.text: So that was certainly the case with Memento.
cues.en: So that was certainly the case with Memento.
cues.zh: 《記憶碎片》的情況確實如此。

cues.text: First way to draw it is, as I have like that.
cues.en: First way to draw it is, as I have like that.
cues.zh: 第一種繪製方法是，就像我那樣。

cues.text: That's basically the end of the movie.
cues.en: That's basically the end of the movie.
cues.zh: 電影基本上就這樣結束了。

cues.text: This stuff is the black and white stuff.
cues.en: This stuff is the black and white stuff.
cues.zh: 這個東西就是黑白的東西。

cues.text: This is color.
cues.en: This is color.
cues.zh: 這是顏色。

cues.text: And what we do is we cut between the two, the whole way through.
cues.en: And what we do is we cut between the two, the whole way through.
cues.zh: 我們所做的就是在兩者之間進行切入，從始至終。

cues.text: You said we talked before. I don`t remember that.
cues.en: You said we talked before. I don`t remember that.
cues.zh: 你說我們之前談過。我不記得了。

cues.text: So we alternate scene here, scene there, scene there,scene there,
cues.en: So we alternate scene here, scene there, scene there,scene there,
cues.zh: 所以我們交替這裡的場景，那裡的場景，那裡的場景，那裡的場景，

cues.text: and they meet towards the end of the film.
cues.en: and they meet towards the end of the film.
cues.zh: 他們在電影接近尾聲時相遇了。

cues.text: The thing that I started to develop and I've carried on over since that there's most certainly is probably cross-cutting.
cues.en: The thing that I started to develop and I've carried on over since that there's most certainly is probably cross-cutting.
cues.zh: 我開始開發並一直堅持下去的東西很可能是橫切的。

cues.text: I always trying intercut scenes.
cues.en: I always trying intercut scenes.
cues.zh: 我總是嘗試交叉剪輯場景。

cues.text: Based on a concept from music called a shepherd progression or shepard tone.
cues.en: Based on a concept from music called a shepherd progression or shepard tone.
cues.zh: 基於音樂中稱為牧羊人進行或牧羊人音調的概念。

cues.text: It's a series of ascending notes on a scale that by emphasizing in volume different elements of the scale,
cues.en: It's a series of ascending notes on a scale that by emphasizing in volume different elements of the scale,
cues.zh: 它是音階上的一系列上升音符，透過在音量上強調音階的不同元素，

cues.text: it can continuously go up, like a corkscrew effect or a barbershop hole.
cues.en: it can continuously go up, like a corkscrew effect or a barbershop hole.
cues.zh: 它可以不斷上升，就像螺旋效應或理髮店的洞一樣。

cues.text: It's always rising.
cues.en: It's always rising.
cues.zh: 它總是在上漲。

cues.text: As one storyline is peeking, and other one is building, and the third one is just starting out.
cues.en: As one storyline is peeking, and other one is building, and the third one is just starting out.
cues.zh: 一個故事情節正在醞釀之中，另一個故事情節正在構建，而第三個故事情節才剛剛開始。

cues.text: Full speed, Peter.
cues.en: Full speed, Peter.
cues.zh: 全速前進，彼得。

cues.text: Keep coming round.
cues.en: Keep coming round.
cues.zh: 繼續過來。

cues.text: Keep coming.
cues.en: Keep coming.
cues.zh: 繼續來。

cues.text: Before he fires, he`s gotta drop his nose. I'll give you the signal.
cues.en: Before he fires, he`s gotta drop his nose. I'll give you the signal.
cues.zh: 在開槍之前，他必須先把鼻子放下來。我會給你訊號。

cues.text: Now? No, wait.
cues.en: Now? No, wait.
cues.zh: 現在？不，等等。

cues.text: Wait for him to commit to his line.
cues.en: Wait for him to commit to his line.
cues.zh: 等待他遵守他的路線。

cues.text: You create a continuing rise in intensity, narratively.
cues.en: You create a continuing rise in intensity, narratively.
cues.zh: 你在敘事上創造了強度的持續上升。

cues.text: Now.
cues.en: Now.
cues.zh: 現在。

cues.text: That's really an approach that I've carried on using through all my films.
cues.en: That's really an approach that I've carried on using through all my films.
cues.zh: 這確實是我在所有電影中一直使用的一種方法。

cues.text: As a director, you have to be able to not look at the shot as a two-dimensional picture, but look at where everything is in three-dimensional space.
cues.en: As a director, you have to be able to not look at the shot as a two-dimensional picture, but look at where everything is in three-dimensional space.
cues.zh: 身為導演，你不能把鏡頭當作二維圖片來看待，而是要看到一切在三維空間中的位置。

cues.text: And go easy on the poor chap.
cues.en: And go easy on the poor chap.
cues.zh: 對這個可憐的傢伙寬容一點。

cues.text: He does try so very hard.
cues.en: He does try so very hard.
cues.zh: 他確實非常努力。

cues.text: That's why I don't use a monitor on set to this day.
cues.en: That's why I don't use a monitor on set to this day.
cues.zh: 這就是為什麼我至今不在片場使用監視器。

cues.text: I just say by the camera because I want to see where is the camera?
cues.en: I just say by the camera because I want to see where is the camera?
cues.zh: 我只是說透過相機，因為我想看看相機在哪裡？

cues.text: Why is the camera? Where it is?
cues.en: Why is the camera? Where it is?
cues.zh: 為什麼是相機？它在哪裡？

cues.text: And then place the camera according to my idea of what the point of view is.
cues.en: And then place the camera according to my idea of what the point of view is.
cues.zh: 然後根據我的想法來放置相機。

cues.text: I`d like to try and align the audience quite closely with the point of view of a character.
cues.en: I`d like to try and align the audience quite closely with the point of view of a character.
cues.zh: 我想嘗試讓觀眾與角色的觀點緊密結合。

cues.text: Come on.
cues.en: Come on.
cues.zh: 快點。

cues.text: The use of inserts, something I've maintained it all my films.
cues.en: The use of inserts, something I've maintained it all my films.
cues.zh: 插入的使用，是我在所有電影中都保留的東西。

cues.text: There is a form of narrative connection that's made through objects.
cues.en: There is a form of narrative connection that's made through objects.
cues.zh: 有一種透過物體建立的敘事連結。

cues.text: Don't believe his lies.
cues.en: Don't believe his lies.
cues.zh: 不要相信他的謊言。

cues.text: He is the one. Kill him.
cues.en: He is the one. Kill him.
cues.zh: 他就是那個。殺了他。

cues.text: I finally found him.
cues.en: I finally found him.
cues.zh: 我終於找到他了。

cues.text: We also did it for technical reasons because one of the things you can do with very little time
cues.en: We also did it for technical reasons because one of the things you can do with very little time
cues.zh: 我們這樣做也是出於技術原因，因為這是你可以用很少的時間完成的事情之一

cues.text: is you can shoot a really beautiful insert.
cues.en: is you can shoot a really beautiful insert.
cues.zh: 就是你可以拍出非常漂亮的插頁。

cues.text: You can soft light it from the side.
cues.en: You can soft light it from the side.
cues.zh: 您可以從側面柔和地照亮它。

cues.text: You can throw out the lens, you can get something that looks really nice, very quickly.
cues.en: You can throw out the lens, you can get something that looks really nice, very quickly.
cues.zh: 你可以丟掉鏡頭，很快就能得到看起來非常漂亮的東西。

cues.text: My fascination with storytelling in films is all about that subjectivity.
cues.en: My fascination with storytelling in films is all about that subjectivity.
cues.zh: 我對電影說故事的著迷完全在於這種主觀。

cues.text: It's all about, whose point of view my seeing the story from.
cues.en: It's all about, whose point of view my seeing the story from.
cues.zh: 關鍵在於我從誰的角度來看這個故事。

cues.text: Don't use zoom lenses.
cues.en: Don't use zoom lenses.
cues.zh: 不要使用變焦鏡頭。

cues.text: If you don't use zoom lenses, then you are having to physically move the camera,
cues.en: If you don't use zoom lenses, then you are having to physically move the camera,
cues.zh: 如果你不使用變焦鏡頭，那麼你就必須移動相機，

cues.text: closer or further away to what you`re photographing.
cues.en: closer or further away to what you`re photographing.
cues.zh: 離您所拍攝的物體更近或更遠。

cues.text: So there's a scene in the film where you make a telephone call, and I remember when you came in to sit down to do the scene,
cues.en: So there's a scene in the film where you make a telephone call, and I remember when you came in to sit down to do the scene,
cues.zh: 電影裡有一個場景，你打電話，我記得當你進來坐下來拍這個場景的時候，

cues.text: and you're pretty surprised where the camera was, because it was pretty close to your nose on a 75,
cues.en: and you're pretty surprised where the camera was, because it was pretty close to your nose on a 75,
cues.zh: 你會對相機的位置感到非常驚訝，因為在 75 上它離你的鼻子非常近，

cues.text: but what I found is when we put the camera right there in your space,
cues.en: but what I found is when we put the camera right there in your space,
cues.zh: 但我發現當我們把相機放在你的空間裡時，

cues.text: the performance is then exactly appropriate to somebody being that close and being so in your head.
cues.en: the performance is then exactly appropriate to somebody being that close and being so in your head.
cues.zh: 這樣的表演就非常適合那些離你那麼近並且在你腦海裡的人。

cues.text: It really helps.
cues.en: It really helps.
cues.zh: 這確實有幫助。

cues.text: Trish, listen, I`m...
cues.en: Trish, listen, I`m...
cues.zh: 翠西，聽著，我...

cues.text: And I think, that was the right approach for me and set me on the path
cues.en: And I think, that was the right approach for me and set me on the path
cues.zh: 我認為，這對我來說是正確的方法，讓我走上了這條道路

cues.text: of always thinking about considering the point of view of the storytelling.
cues.en: of always thinking about considering the point of view of the storytelling.
cues.zh: 總是考慮說故事的觀點。

cues.text: This is what happens when an unstoppable force meets an immovable object.
cues.en: This is what happens when an unstoppable force meets an immovable object.
cues.zh: 這就是當不可阻擋的力量遇到不可移動的物體時會發生的情況。

cues.text: You truly are incorruptible, aren't you, huh?
cues.en: You truly are incorruptible, aren't you, huh?
cues.zh: 你真是清廉啊，不是嗎？

cues.text: You won't kill me out of some misplaced sense of self-righteousness,
cues.en: You won't kill me out of some misplaced sense of self-righteousness,
cues.zh: 你不會因為某種錯誤的自以為是而殺了我

cues.text: and I won't kill you because you're just too much fun.
cues.en: and I won't kill you because you're just too much fun.
cues.zh: 我不會殺你，因為你太有趣了。

cues.text: I think you and I are destined to do this forever.
cues.en: I think you and I are destined to do this forever.
cues.zh: 我想你和我註定要永遠這樣做。

cues.text: One of the great joys as a director is constructing a world.
cues.en: One of the great joys as a director is constructing a world.
cues.zh: 身為導演的一大樂趣就是建構一個世界。

cues.text: On my films I try to shoot as much in-camera as possible.
cues.en: On my films I try to shoot as much in-camera as possible.
cues.zh: 在我的電影中，我嘗試盡可能在相機內拍攝。

cues.text: So trying to do these things for real.
cues.en: So trying to do these things for real.
cues.zh: 所以嘗試真正做這些事情。

cues.text: There's nothing more dispiriting when you tell off to work in this just a green screen, the collectors in front of it.
cues.en: There's nothing more dispiriting when you tell off to work in this just a green screen, the collectors in front of it.
cues.zh: 當你在這只是一個綠色螢幕上工作時，沒有什麼比這更令人沮喪的了，收藏家就在它前面。

cues.text: It's really - the magics not there.
cues.en: It's really - the magics not there.
cues.zh: 真的——魔法不存在。

cues.text: For example on Interstellar, we didn't use any green screens.
cues.en: For example on Interstellar, we didn't use any green screens.
cues.zh: 例如，在《星際效應》中，我們沒有使用任何綠幕。

cues.text: We built a set and we enhanced it with visual effects.
cues.en: We built a set and we enhanced it with visual effects.
cues.zh: 我們建立了一個場景，並透過視覺效果對其進行了增強。

cues.text: You've seen the time is represented here as a physical dimension.
cues.en: You've seen the time is represented here as a physical dimension.
cues.zh: 您已經看到時間在這裡表示為物理維度。

cues.text: You have worked out that you can exert a force across space-time.
cues.en: You have worked out that you can exert a force across space-time.
cues.zh: 你已經發現你可以跨越時空施加力量。

cues.text: Gravity to send a message.
cues.en: Gravity to send a message.
cues.zh: 重力傳送訊息。

cues.text: Affirmative.
cues.en: Affirmative.
cues.zh: 肯定。

cues.text: So try to use real locations, I've always preferred real locations.
cues.en: So try to use real locations, I've always preferred real locations.
cues.zh: 所以嘗試使用真實的地點，我一直更喜歡真實的地點。

cues.text: If you can believe in it, if you can relate it to the textures of everyday life,
cues.en: If you can believe in it, if you can relate it to the textures of everyday life,
cues.zh: 如果你能相信它，如果你能將它與日常生活的質感連結起來，

cues.text: you're taking the audience on a more extreme journey.
cues.en: you're taking the audience on a more extreme journey.
cues.zh: 你正在帶領觀眾踏上更極限的旅程。

cues.text: With no word from the Batman even as they mourn Commissioner Loeb, these cops have to be wondering,
cues.en: With no word from the Batman even as they mourn Commissioner Loeb, these cops have to be wondering,
cues.zh: 即使在哀悼勒佈局長的同時，蝙蝠俠也沒有任何訊息，這些警察一定會想，

cues.text: if the Joker will make good on his threat and in the albitrary column of the Gotham Times to kill the mayor.
cues.en: if the Joker will make good on his threat and in the albitrary column of the Gotham Times to kill the mayor.
cues.zh: 如果小丑兌現他的威脅，並在《哥譚時報》的任意專欄中殺死市長。

cues.text: Really everything you do, you learn from.
cues.en: Really everything you do, you learn from.
cues.zh: 事實上，你所做的一切，你都可以從中學習。

cues.text: In terms of anytime you shooting something short film.
cues.en: In terms of anytime you shooting something short film.
cues.zh: 就你拍攝短片的任何時間而言。

cues.text: You're always learning about your craft.
cues.en: You're always learning about your craft.
cues.zh: 你總是在學習你的手藝。

cues.text: It gives you confidence as a filmmaker.
cues.en: It gives you confidence as a filmmaker.
cues.zh: 它給你作為電影製片人的信心。

cues.text: I think really the only useful advice I ever got in terms of trying to figure out your way
cues.en: I think really the only useful advice I ever got in terms of trying to figure out your way
cues.zh: 我認為這確實是我在嘗試找出自己的出路方面得到的唯一有用的建議

cues.text: in to the film business and film industry is to get yourself a script
cues.en: in to the film business and film industry is to get yourself a script
cues.zh: 進入電影產業和電影產業就是給自己找一個劇本

cues.text: and hang on to it.
cues.en: and hang on to it.
cues.zh: 並堅持下去。

cues.text: You have to play to your strengths, you have to do something that really excites you and what was different about that.
cues.en: You have to play to your strengths, you have to do something that really excites you and what was different about that.
cues.zh: 你必須發揮自己的優勢，你必須做一些真正讓你興奮的事情，以及與此不同的事情。

cues.text: It's that idea that screenplay, that concept that's so important.
cues.en: It's that idea that screenplay, that concept that's so important.
cues.zh: 劇本的這個想法、這個概念非常重要。

cues.text: And that was going to distinguish it, if you can do it successfully.
cues.en: And that was going to distinguish it, if you can do it successfully.
cues.zh: 如果你能成功的話，那就將它區分開來。
